repo_notes.content: Spotilol is an Android app (package com.project.lol) that wraps the Spotify Web Player in a WebView with built-in ad blocking. It injects custom JS/CSS to block ads/analytics, spoof the browser fingerprint, bypass GDPR dialogs, add a custom player, download tracks offline and expose a library browser. Written in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose (Material3). Clean-Kotlin port of deviato's Spotifuck, maintained by lyssadev. minSdk 28, targetSdk 36, compileSdk 37, versionName 1.2.3 (versionCode 22). Priority areas: webview/ (JS injection engine), service/ (media + offline playback + downloads), offline/ + innertube/ + yt/ (YouTube-backed offline downloads), and bridge/ (JS <-> Kotlin). There is no proxy/MITM layer anymore - only a pref migration stub (migrateProxyEraPrefs) is left in SpotilolApp.
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: webview/ is the core engine. WebViewHost is a singleton that owns the shared WebView (desktop UA, JS/DOM enabled, hardware layer, silent.mp3 asset, document-start script registration, renderer-gone release, AndBridge attached as a JavascriptInterface). SpotifyWebViewClient orchestrates per-page JS injection and request interception; SpotifyWebChromeClient handles fullscreen/custom view and progress. webview/injections/ now holds 49 Kotlin objects, each exposing a const val CONTENT with raw JavaScript. webview/helpers/ holds JsUtils, AmoledTheme, CssInjector, AdBlocker, AdIdStore, DevLogPrelude, LyricsTheme and NavToken.
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: Injection order matters. The early payload (registered as a DOCUMENT_START script for open.spotify.com, and re-injected on onPageStarted as fallback) is: pref flags (showScrollbar/powerSave/hideEmpty/playlistSort + pageshow reload guard), then BrowserSpoof (or GoogleSpoof on google/youtube hosts), FetchOverride, AdStateHook, WorkerNeutralize (only if BlockServiceWorker), GaBlocker, PowerSave, SettingsFix, VideoPark, NavDuck. The player payload (injectPlayerControl, scheduled ~500ms after onPageFinished when logged in) starts with PlayerCore (defines globals first) then TrackObserver, ClassicBridge, MediaUpdater, LibraryFetcher, LibraryParser, PlaybackControls, AndroidAuto, MainLoop, AutoFeatures, AndroidTracker, SearchOverlay, DownloadButton, DownloadProgress, CollectionDownload, ContextMenuDownload, an inline recAccountName poller, CssHack, ContextMenuSheet, WatchFeed, ModalFix, ErrorDialogRestyle, ToastFix, LyricsSyncFix, QueueAutoClose, LibraryAutoClose, PlaylistSort, ColumnsButton, SpicyLyrics, WebPrefs, and finally - only when PlayerMode is spotilol or fullscreen - SpotilolPlayer, VideoFullscreen, LyricsPip. PlayerMode supports three values: spotilol, fullscreen and original.
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: service/ contains MediaNotificationService (a MediaBrowserServiceCompat providing the foreground media notification, lock-screen/Bluetooth controls and Android Auto browsing/search/playback via MediaSessionCompat, wakeAndRun to resume a backgrounded WebView and execute JS, custom actions for favorite/shuffle/repeat, and Bluetooth/noisy-audio auto pause/resume), OfflineMediaService (foreground player for downloaded tracks with its own MediaSession), and DownloadService (a dataSync foreground service that hosts the downloader). MediaSearch builds the JS used by onPlayFromSearch. bridge/SpotifyBridge exposes @JavascriptInterface methods to the WebView as window.AndBridge: loginDetected, playLoaded, deferMessage, isWoke/wakeUp/wakeOff, cssInjected, recMediaStatus/recMediaPosition, recAccountName, recAdContentIds, onMediaItemsLoaded/onSearchCompleted (Android Auto), downloadTrack/downloadCollection, skipDownload/cancelDownload, enterPip/enterPipVideo, enterVideoFullscreen/exitVideoFullscreen, enterLyricsPip, playerExpanded, wideVideo, ctxMenuState, openTimerDialog, manageTShut/manageTSleep, dbg, clearDebugLog, spicyLyrics, and nFetch (native fetch fallback used by ClassicBridge).
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: offline/ implements YouTube-backed offline downloads. DownloadManager + OfflineStore resolve Spotify track metadata, search YouTube via the custom InnerTube client under innertube/ (InnerTube, YouTube, NetworkConfig, YouTubeConstants, models/, pages/, utils/), then extract streamable audio under yt/ (YTPlayerUtils, AudioQuality, CandidateScorer, WebViewHealth, cipher/ with PlayerJsFetcher + CipherDeobfuscator, potoken/ PoToken generation, sabr/ streaming parser). Supporting stores: DownloadFolder, DownloadPrefs, DownloadStatus, OfflinePlaylistStore and LocalImportStore (imports local audio files with an imported_meta.json manifest). offline/audio/ does encoding and tagging: Mp3Encoder (via :lame), M4aEncoder + Mp4Remux + Mp4Tags, Id3Tags/Tags and WebmOpusReader (via :opus).
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: Feature packages: profile/ProfileManager (saved account profiles), timer/SleepTimerManager (sleep timer with COUNTDOWN and END_OF_SONG modes and PAUSE/QUIT actions, surfaced by SleepTimerDialog and the bridge openTimerDialog), spicy/SpicyLyricsClient + SpicyKey (lyrics from api.spicylyrics.org with an lrclib.net fallback and an LRU cache), searchEngine/GenericSearchEngine + SearchableFieldExtractor (fuzzy keyword scorer used for offline/Android Auto search), widget/ (Glance home-screen widgets: SpotilolPlayerWidget + SpotilolArtWidget, with WidgetActions, WidgetCover, WidgetState and WidgetUpdater persisted via DataStore), util/ (Logger + LogFilter, CrashHandler/CrashStore/CrashReport/ReportSections, DeviceInfo, PlaybackDiagnostics, Telemetry, UpdateChecker + GitHubApi, AppLocale, BuildInfo, Markdown). ui/ has SplashActivity, MainActivity, OfflineActivity, CrashActivity and Compose screens/settings/theme.
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: High-level architecture of Spotilol: how the WebView, JS injection engine, Android services, Android Auto integration, home-screen widgets and the YouTube-backed offline downloader interact to wrap and enhance the Spotify Web Player

pages.title: WebView & JS Injection System
pages.purpose: How WebViewHost owns the singleton WebView, how SpotifyWebViewClient orchestrates JS injection per page load (document-start early payload vs onPageFinished player payload vs shouldInterceptRequest ad/analytics blocking), which injections are gated on login state, how NavToken drops stale work across navigations, and how SpotifyWebChromeClient handles child windows and fullscreen video

pages.title: JS Injection Objects Reference
pages.purpose: Detailed reference for each of the 49 JS injection objects in webview/injections/ - what each one does, its key exported window functions/variables, and when it is injected. Cover ad-blocking/anti-tracking (AdStateHook, GaBlocker, WorkerNeutralize, FetchOverride, AndroidTracker), spoofing (BrowserSpoof, GoogleSpoof), player core + globals (PlayerCore, TrackObserver, MediaUpdater, PlaybackControls, MainLoop, ClassicBridge), Android Auto JS (AndroidAuto), downloads (DownloadButton, DownloadProgress, CollectionDownload, ContextMenuDownload), lyrics (LyricsSyncFix, SpicyLyrics, LyricsPip), UI/layout (CssHack, SpotilolPlayer, AutoFeatures, PowerSave, SearchOverlay, ContextMenuSheet, WatchFeed, PlaylistSort, ColumnsButton, LibraryAutoClose, QueueAutoClose, VideoPark, VideoFullscreen, WebPrefs, NavDuck, NpHeaderFix, PlaylistLookupSheet, ScrollbarAutoHide) and page helpers (ClassicLoginButton, FbGdprBypass, LoginDetection, LogoutCheck, SettingsFix, ModalFix, ErrorDialogRestyle, ToastFix). Note the exact injection order, since PlayerCore defines the globals the rest rely on

pages.title: Helper Utilities
pages.purpose: Documentation of webview/helpers/: JsUtils (console.log stripping algorithm + cache), AmoledTheme (AMOLED CSS builder), CssInjector (custom CSS injection), AdBlocker + AdIdStore (analytics/ad CDN blocking and request-id tracking), DevLogPrelude (debug overlay logging hooks), LyricsTheme (lyrics style engine) and NavToken (per-navigation generation counter used to discard stale injections and callbacks)

pages.title: Lyrics System
pages.purpose: How lyrics work end to end: the LyricsStyle setting built by LyricsTheme (default/fullscreen/compact/karaoke/bold, injected as <style id="spotilol-lyrics-style"> so it never clobbers CustomCss), the SpicyLyrics injection backed by SpicyLyricsClient (api.spicylyrics.org with an lrclib.net fallback, LRU cache, bridge method spicyLyrics), LyricsSyncFix, and LyricsPip with the bridge enterLyricsPip

pages.title: Kotlin-JS Bridge (SpotifyBridge)
pages.purpose: Document every @JavascriptInterface method exposed to the WebView as window.AndBridge: loginDetected, playLoaded, deferMessage, isWoke/wakeUp/wakeOff, cssInjected, recMediaStatus/recMediaPosition, recAccountName, recAdContentIds, onMediaItemsLoaded/onSearchCompleted (Android Auto), downloadTrack/downloadCollection, skipDownload/cancelDownload, enterPip/enterPipVideo, enterVideoFullscreen/exitVideoFullscreen, enterLyricsPip, playerExpanded, wideVideo, ctxMenuState, openTimerDialog, manageTShut/manageTSleep, dbg, clearDebugLog, spicyLyrics, and the nFetch native-fetch fallback used by ClassicBridge

pages.title: Media Notification & Android Auto Service
pages.purpose: How MediaNotificationService (a MediaBrowserServiceCompat) provides: the foreground media notification, lock-screen/Bluetooth/Wear controls via MediaSessionCompat, Android Auto root categories (playlists/albums/artists/podcasts) + async onLoadChildren/onSearch with pendingCallbacks and timeouts, onPlayFromMediaId + onPlayFromSearch (via MediaSearch) + wakeAndRun (resumeTimers/onResume/visibility) to execute JS while the WebView is backgrounded, custom actions (favorite/shuffle/repeat), Bluetooth/noisy audio auto pause/resume, and metadata/cover art loading

pages.title: Android Auto Media Browsing Flow
pages.purpose: End-to-end flow for Android Auto: onGetRoot extras, root categories, JS fetchMediaItems/checkMediaLib/pendingMediaRequests draining via window.mediaLib, JSON payload parsing (name/id/image/artists/browsable flags) back in Kotlin onMediaItemsLoaded, onSearch (searchDesktop GQL), and playback via playFromUri(mediaId, contextId) -> connect-state command

pages.title: Offline Playback Service
pages.purpose: How OfflineMediaService plays downloaded tracks as a foreground service with its own MediaSession, and how it relates to the offline/ stores (OfflineStore, OfflinePlaylistStore, LocalImportStore) and the main webview player

pages.title: Offline Downloads (YouTube-backed)
pages.purpose: How the offline downloader works: DownloadService + DownloadManager consume a Spotify track payload from JS (DownloadButton/DownloadProgress/CollectionDownload/ContextMenuDownload), resolve metadata, search YouTube, extract an audio stream, download it, encode/tag it under offline/audio/, and store it via OfflineStore/OfflinePlaylistStore for OfflineMediaService - plus LocalImportStore for importing existing local audio files and the DownloadFormat (MP3/M4A) / DownloadFolder / DownloadPrefs settings

pages.title: YouTube InnerTube Client
pages.purpose: Documentation of innertube/: the custom InnerTube API client (InnerTube.kt, YouTube.kt, NetworkConfig.kt, YouTubeConstants.kt), its serialized models under models/, pagination/search under pages/ (PageHelper, SearchPage, NewPipe), and utils/ - including how search and player responses are parsed for the offline downloader

pages.title: YouTube Audio Extraction & Cipher
pages.purpose: Documentation of yt/: YTPlayerUtils, AudioQuality selection, CandidateScorer, WebViewHealth, and the signature-cipher deobfuscation (cipher/ with PlayerJsFetcher + CipherDeobfuscator), PoToken/anti-bot generation (potoken/), and SABR streaming (sabr/) used to resolve playable audio streams

pages.title: Offline Audio Encoding & Tags
pages.purpose: Documentation of offline/audio/: how a resolved YouTube stream is turned into a stored file - WebmOpusReader (via :opus) for the source, Mp3Encoder (via :lame) and M4aEncoder + Mp4Remux for the outputs, and the tag writers (Id3Tags, Mp4Tags, Tags) that embed title/artist/album/cover art

pages.title: Home Screen Widgets
pages.purpose: How the Glance home-screen widgets work: SpotilolPlayerWidget (transport + like/shuffle/repeat controls) and SpotilolArtWidget (album art), the WidgetState model and WidgetUpdater (DataStore-backed persistence), WidgetActions (button intents routed back to the services) and WidgetCover (cover loading/cropping), plus their manifest receivers and widget_info XML

pages.title: Sleep Timer
pages.purpose: How SleepTimerManager pauses or quits playback after a countdown or at the end of the current song (COUNTDOWN / END_OF_SONG modes, PAUSE / QUIT actions), how it is driven from SleepTimerDialog and the bridge openTimerDialog, and how it coordinates with MediaNotificationService and OfflineMediaService

pages.title: UI Layer
pages.purpose: Documentation of ui/: MainActivity (Jetpack Compose host for the WebView, custom player overlay, PiP, video fullscreen, service start/stop, deeplinks, widget and sleep-timer wiring), SplashActivity (animated splash), OfflineActivity + screens/OfflineScreen (downloaded/imported tracks), CrashActivity (post-crash report screen), components/ (SettingsDialog edge-to-edge Material 3 dialog, ChangelogDialog, ErrorScreen, SleepTimerDialog), screens/SettingsScreen (all preferences grouped in five tabs - Appearance, Playback, Content, Advanced and About - covering language, GuiHack/CustomCss, MaterialYou/theme presets/AmoledTheme, hide top bar, landscape, keep screen on, scrollbar, APlayMode, PlayerMode spotilol/fullscreen/original, WebCanvas/WebVideos, hide empty player, playlist sort, lyrics style, SpicyLyrics, TakeControl, Android Auto, CloseNowPlay, Bluetooth pause/resume/headphone-plug, offline mode, BlockServiceWorker, download format/folder/tags, profiles and the About links; the DEBUG section is hidden until five taps on the WebView Engine tile in About and is locked again by holding that tile, and it holds Collect Debug, Open Logger, Export Device Info and Crash Test), and theme/ (Raleway font family, AMOLED dark theme, theme presets, Material You accent)

pages.title: Profile Manager
pages.purpose: How ProfileManager stores, switches, saves, and deletes user account profiles (cookies/auth state per profile) and how it interacts with the account name detection (recAccountName) in the JS bridge

pages.title: Diagnostics, Crash Reporting & Logging
pages.purpose: Documentation of the diagnostics stack: Logger + LogFilter (ring buffer, debug overlay, persisted Collect Debug toggle), CrashHandler (uncaught-exception handler) feeding CrashStore and CrashActivity, CrashReport + ReportSections + DeviceInfo + PlaybackDiagnostics (shared device/crash report sections), and Telemetry (Firebase analytics/performance gating) - including the experimental Extract Device Info and Crash Test tiles

pages.title: Utilities
pages.purpose: Documentation of the remaining util/: UpdateChecker + GitHubApi (release version checking against GitHub releases), AppLocale (per-app language + attachBaseContext wrapping), BuildInfo, and Markdown (rendering helper)

pages.title: Build & Configuration
pages.purpose: Build system (Gradle Kotlin DSL + version catalog gradle/libs.versions.toml, AGP 9.4.1, Kotlin 2.4.0, Compose BOM), module structure (app/ plus the :lame and :opus native modules), ABI filters, release signing via keystore/keystore.properties, ProGuard keep rules for the JS bridge and BouncyCastle, Firebase google-services.json requirement, AndroidManifest declarations (SplashActivity launcher, MainActivity deeplinks + PiP, OfflineActivity, CrashActivity, the three services, MediaButtonReceiver, the two widget receivers), cleartext traffic disabled, and the automotive_app_desc / widget_info XML
